clue.text: Outstanding screen director

parts.note: outstanding means super, excellent
a visor is a screen protecting the eyes

explanation.surface: Praise for a brilliant film director.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Screen director' suggests cinema, but 'director' alone is the definition, in the sense of an overseer.
explanation.definitionFit: A boss who oversees and directs the work of others is a synonym.

clue.text: Safe win

definitions.meaning: to win something is to obtain or get it

explanation.definitionFit: Protected means safe, and to obtain a prize is to win it.

clue.text: Jump softly on animal

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed on top of the next piece

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical direction for softly
the ounce is the snow leopard

explanation.surface: A cat creeping up quietly before leaping on its prey.
explanation.definitionFit: To spring suddenly on prey is to leap or jump.

clue.text: Hotel guests may be taken in by her

definitions.text: Hotel guests may be taken in by her

parts.words: Hotel guests may be taken in by her
parts.note: taken in sounds like deceived but means checked in at the front desk

explanation.definitionFit: The front-desk worker at a hotel who checks in arriving guests.

clue.text: Shakespeare character having a turn after one

indicators.note: after tells us a turn comes following the letter for one

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one is I
a go is a turn in a game

explanation.surface: An actor playing a Shakespeare role who waits his turn.
explanation.definitionFit: The scheming villain of Othello is a Shakespearean figure.

clue.text: Deep science

parts.note: not profound learning but the study of the deep, the sea

explanation.definitionFit: The scientific study of the sea, which is called the deep.

clue.text: It parts with its teeth

parts.note: not an animal biting but a grooming tool whose tines make a parting in hair

explanation.definitionFit: A grooming tool with a row of teeth used to make a parting in the hair.

clue.text: Provide a remedy when given too much to take home perhaps

definitions.text: given too much to take home perhaps

indicators.note: a remedy fixes or alters things, so the letters of the words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone who offers a cure and earns a hefty fee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take home' is take-home pay, wages after deductions.
explanation.definitionFit: Receiving more wages than deserved; take-home pay is one example of what is paid.

clue.text: Banter that's offensive for the elderly

parts.note: offensive means bad, nasty
the elderly are those in age, advanced in years

explanation.surface: Jokes that are considered rude by older people.
explanation.definitionFit: Playful teasing repartee is banter.

clue.text: Person regularly in service

parts.note: not a servant or soldier but someone who attends worship services every week

explanation.definitionFit: A worshipper who attends religious services faithfully every week.

clue.text: Less than a shilling for nurse

definitions.meaning: ten pence in old money, written 10d; a shilling was twelve old pennies
to nurse is to look after or care for

explanation.walkthrough: Before 1971 British money had twelve pennies (d) to the shilling, so TEN D was less than a shilling.
explanation.definitionFit: Ten old pennies fell short of a shilling, and to care for the sick is to nurse them.

clue.text: See about supporting newspaper's concise writing style

indicators.note: in a down clue supporting puts one piece underneath the other

parts.note: the Daily Telegraph is the newspaper in which this puzzle appears

indicators.note: about tells us to turn around and rearrange the letters of See

explanation.surface: A note directing readers to the paper's terse house style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' scrambles SEE to give ESE, placed under the newspaper's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The clipped style of old telegrams, omitting small words, is a terse prose manner.

clue.text: Piecemeal instructions

parts.note: read as piece-meal: step-by-step directions for making a meal

explanation.definitionFit: Cooking directions set out step by step for preparing a dish.

clue.text: Bounder pinched part of support

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A cad has stolen some of the funds meant to keep things going.
explanation.definitionFit: To underpin is to support from below, like shoring up a foundation.

clue.text: Blot out former pupil able to read and write

parts.note: OB, Old Boy, is a former pupil of a school
literate means able to read and write

explanation.surface: A school alumnus who can write is told to cross something out.
explanation.definitionFit: To erase or destroy completely is to blot out.

clue.text: One gets sceptical from living beside eccentric

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, telling us to scramble the letters of the words before it

explanation.surface: Living next to an oddball makes a person doubtful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eccentric' rearranges LIVING BESIDE; 'One gets' and 'from' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Doubting what one is told is being sceptical.

clue.text: Yellow and white container

parts.note: the yellow and white are the yolk and albumen held inside

explanation.definitionFit: The brittle casing that holds an egg's yolk and albumen.

clue.text: American expression meaning the end!

parts.note: a term is a word or expression
American means in the US

explanation.walkthrough: 'American expression' reads as a term in US; 'meaning' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The last stop of a railway or bus line is its end point.

clue.text: Despite being inexperienced, touches with a knack of growing things

parts.note: green means new to something, naive
to finger something is to touch it

explanation.surface: A novice gardener somehow has a natural talent for plants.
explanation.walkthrough: GREEN FINGERS is the British idiom for gardening talent (American 'green thumb').
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names a natural talent for gardening and making plants thrive.

clue.text: Middle Easterner catches you and me getting back in

parts.note: ye is an old form of you
taken as written

indicators.note: getting back tells us the word in is read the other way round

explanation.surface: An Arab traveller picks up two friends on the return journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting back' turns IN into NI; 'catches' and 'and' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Yemen in Arabia is a Middle Easterner.

clue.text: Hate having empty machine

indicators.note: having means holding, so the machine contains the letter

parts.note: a lathe is a machine for turning wood or metal
empty means nothing, zero, the letter O

explanation.definitionFit: To loathe is to detest, a strong synonym for hate.

clue.text: Steers me round the course

indicators.note: round suggests turning the letters about, so the words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A driver guiding someone around a racecourse.
explanation.definitionFit: A term of an academic year is a course of study.

clue.text: Hurry, there's nothing on the clock

indicators.note: on tells us the letter for nothing is attached after the word for hurry

parts.note: to hurry is to speed
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A rush to finish before the clock runs out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the clock' is slang for a car's speedometer, informally a SPEEDO.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal British slang: a vehicle's speedometer dial is called the clock.

clue.text: Half take care of sort of pancake

indicators.note: half tells us to take the first two letters of the four-letter word take

parts.note: c/o, CO, is the abbreviation for care of

explanation.surface: Cooking instructions telling you to mind half the pancakes.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mexican folded tortilla, likened here to a kind of pancake.

clue.text: Neat sort of heating-vessel!

indicators.note: sort here is a verb-like signal to rearrange the letters of the word Neat

explanation.surface: A tidy little kettle described as a kind of tidy heater.
explanation.definitionFit: An etna is a small spirit lamp vessel for heating liquids, named after the volcano.

clue.text: Governing body cope with books about Middle East

parts.note: to cope is to manage
NT, the New Testament, is a collection of books

explanation.surface: Bosses dealing with reports on the Middle East.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' and 'about' are link words here, the pieces simply following one another.
explanation.definitionFit: The directors or bosses who run a company form its governing body.

clue.text: Beat on the lid

definitions.meaning: to beat is to whip or flog
an eyelash grows on the eyelid

explanation.definitionFit: To whip is to beat, and a single hair of the eyelash sits on the lid.

clue.text: I'm free to be unusually early

indicators.note: unusually signals the letters are arranged in an unusual way

explanation.surface: Someone happily announcing they have no plans.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic word meaning formerly or earlier, in times past.
